DILG Legal NOV 29 2011 HON. VLADIMIR RAMON B. FRIVALDO Board Member, 2nd District Office of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Capitol Compound, Sorsogon City Dear Board Member Frivaldo: This pertains to your letter seeking this Department's legal opinion on the following queries which we quoted in toto: "1) What is the opinion of the DILG on the creation of the Sorsogon Provincial Management Office (SPMO) as provided for in Executive Order No. 01, series of 2010, hereto attached as Annex B 2) What is the opinion on the legality and validity of the appointment of the Executive Director, who is already operating and running the affairs of the office. The Executive Director, only happens to be the wife of the incumbent governor. The legality or validity of all acts and functions of the Executive Director? The Deputy Executive Director and its other agents? What will happen to the funds allocated to this Office? The communication sent out? 3) What is the opinion on the legality and validity if any of SP Committee Report No. 51-2010 dated July 2010 prepared and signed by Hon. Angel F. Escandor Chairperson of the Committee on Budget and appropriation, hereto reproduced verbatimly: "xxx recommend passage of a supplemental budget in the amount of P500,ooo.oo realigning the same amount from Personal Services Savings of the Office of the Provincial Administrator to Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (General Services) under the same office." Is there any administrative violation or omission if any, of the chair and its members when a Committee, in a committee report recommends for the passage of an ordinance knowing fully that there is no Ordinance yet to create said office. 4) What is the opinion on the legality or validity if any of Panlalawinan Ordinance NO. 22-2010. Ordinance

realigning and/or reverting the amount of five hundred thousand (P500,ooo.oo) pesos, representing personal services savings of the Provincial Administrator's office to Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (General Services) of the same office." Signed by the Secretary to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan William H. Delgado, attested by Vice Mayor and Presiding Officer Antonio H. Escudero, Jr. and approved by Gov. Raul R. Lee. 5) Pursuant to Memorandum Circular No. 146 series of 1992, and Circular No. 92-17 dated July 29, 1992 may we respectfully request for confirmation if Sangguniang Panlalawigan have sent a transmittal letter to your Office regarding the Executive Order 001 Series of 2010 — "An Order creating the Office of the Sorsogon Provincial Management Office of the Province of Sorsogon." In reply to your 1 and 2nd queries, please be informed that Section 463(c) of the Local Government Code of 1991 vested the authority to create offices or consolidate the functions of existing Offices of the provincial government to the sangguniang panlalawigan which provides and we quote: "Section 463. OFFICIAL OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT. - (c) The Sangguniang Panlalawigan may: (1) Maintain existing offices not mentioned in subsections (a) and (b) hereof; (2) Create such other offices as may be necessary to carry out the purposes of the provincial government; or (3) Consolidate the functions of any office with those another in the interest of efficiency and economy." In view thereof, the creation of office of the provincial government is not within the powers and functions of the Provincial Governor since said power is under the law, within the powers and functions of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan. Be that as it may, since Provincial Executive Order No. 001 issued by the Governor creating the Sorsogon Provincial Management Office (SPMO) has already been approved and in fact, already currently being implemented, we are of the view that the same should be accorded the presumption of validity unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. Any issue or question as to its invalidity should already be threshed out by filing a special civil action for Declaratory Relief before the proper court in accordance with Section 1, Rule 63 of the Revised Rules of Court, which provides and we quote: "Section 1. Who may file petition — Any person interested under a deed, will, contract or other written instrument, or whose rights are affected by a statute, executive order or regulation, or ordinance may, before breach or violation thereof, bring an action in the appropriate Regional Trial Court to determine any question of construction or validity arising, and for a declaration of his rights or duties thereunder."

Such being the case, since Provincial Executive Order No. 001 is presumed valid, the appointment of the Executive Director of the Sorsogon Provincial Management Office is therefore valid pursuant to Section 465 (b)(l)(v) which provides, and we quote: "(b) For efficient, effective and economical governance the purpose of which is the general welfare of the province and its inhabitants pursuant to Section 16 of this Code, the provincial governor shall: (1) Exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services and activities of the provincial government, and in this connection, shall: (v) Appoint all officials and employees whose salaries and wages are wholly or mainly paid out of provincial funds and whose appointments are not otherwise provided for in this code, as well as those he may be authorized by law to appoints." In reply to your 3 query, please be informed that if the said report was based on the committee hearing conducted last July 16, 2010 and was duly approved by the members, we are of the view that it is valid. th In reply to your 4 query, as already discussed, an ordinance duly passed and enacted enjoys the presumption of validity unless declared otherwise by our courts of justice. 1 An aggrieved party may question the constitutionality, validity or legality of an ordinance by filing an appropriate action before the Regional Trial Court. In reply to your last query, please be informed that per our records, this Department did not receive any transmittal letter of the Provincial Executive Order No. 001 from the Office of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Sorsogon. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, JESUS B.
